on Thursday unveiled its latest artificial intelligence model aimed at video generation, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash.

The new model is priced at $0.07 per second for up to 720p drafts, which is 30% cheaper than Omni 1.1. It also has support for clips up to 15 seconds, the company said in a post. After drafting the clips at either 360p or 720p, the clips can be upscaled to either 1080p or 4K.

"Built for the everyday videos businesses make in volume — like product videos, virtual try-ons, and ads — this model is fast, cost-effective, and follows your image, video and audio references more closely than before," Google explained.
The new model is generally available in the Gemini API and Gemini for business.
Google shares were lower in midday trading on Thursday, along with a broader decline in tech stocks.

title: Google unveils new Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash AI video model
